verdict.rationale: Termius documents generating 'Biometric keys' that are device-bound and protected by Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics, which covers the biometric-protected key part of the story. The evidence never states that these keys live in hardware-backed secure storage such as a Secure Enclave or TPM, and it offers no setup depth or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: explicit documentation that keys are stored in a hardware-backed secure enclave or TPM, in-depth docs on how biometric keys are created and used, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can store my SSH keys in a hardware-backed secure enclave protected by biometrics

citations.quote: Secure connections with device-bound keys and biometric protection with Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics.
